conf.description: Carbon Black App Control, discovery, syslog-cef: same CEF envelope and regex/label-assertion approach as policy-enforcement, minus the ban/rule/updater custom-string slots which this event class does not carry per the work order's field list. Severity passthrough (already inverted server-side), host.ip combines v4+v6 as an array.

conf.comment: carbon-black-app-control/discovery/syslog-cef. No Elastic integration or Cribl pack exists for App Control; the Cribl 'cef' function is a SERIALIZER ONLY and cannot parse CEF, so the header and extension are recovered with regex_extract, never the cef function. Extension key order is assumed to match this work order's documented field order (a common but unverified assumption for this vendor's connector); a differently-ordered or a record missing a documented key outright will fail this single match (see README gap). deviceCustomString/FloatingPoint/FlexString slot numbers are NOT trusted positionally - each slotLabel is asserted against the vendor-documented label before its value is accepted, per this format's parsing notes, so a future release renumbering slots fails safe (unmapped) rather than silently mismapping.

functions.description: identify technology, dataset, format, and parsing/label-assertion approach

conf.regex: /^CEF:\d+\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|(?<SignatureID>[^|]*)\|(?<Name>[^|]*)\|(?<Severity>[^|]*)\|externalId=(?<externalId>.*?) cat=(?<DeviceEventCategory>.*?) start=(?<startTime>.*?) rt=(?<ReceiptTime>.*?) msg=(?<Message>.*?) dvchost=(?<deviceHostName>.*?) dhost=(?<destinationHostName>.*?) dst=(?<destinationAddress>.*?) c6a3=(?<deviceCustomIPv6Address3>.*?) c6a3Label=(?<deviceCustomIPv6Address3Label>.*?) duser=(?<destinationUserName>.*?) filePath=(?<filePath>.*?) Fileld=(?<Fileld>.*?) cs1=(?<cs1>.*?) cs1Label=(?<cs1Label>.*?) cs2=(?<cs2>.*?) cs2Label=(?<cs2Label>.*?) cs3=(?<cs3>.*?) cs3Label=(?<cs3Label>.*?) cfp1=(?<cfp1>.*?) cfp1Label=(?<cfp1Label>.*?) flexString1=(?<flexString1>.*?) flexString1Label=(?<flexString1Label>.*?) cfp2=(?<cfp2>.*?) cfp2Label=(?<cfp2Label>.*?) flexString2=(?<flexString2>.*?) flexString2Label=(?<flexString2Label>.*)$/

functions.description: split CEF pipe header (SignatureID/Name/Severity) from the extension key=value pairs, bounding each value by the next literal known key so multi-word values (Message, banName, ruleName, threat display strings) are captured whole
compute every derived/label-asserted field from the ORIGINAL regex group names before rename nests them, per compute-before-rename order; drop the raw groups consumed here
batch every status:mapped (or partial/no-transform) extension field into its ECS target
tag event.dataset and drop _raw now that every field has a home
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
